text: Kling AI API Updates API Kling API 2.0 is now available Learn More Purchase Console Sign In Developer Guide API Pricing Updates Updates API Updates API Updates Copy page 08/07/2026 Kling API | New Feature: Webhook Signature Support Added Webhook Signature support: Verify callback requests identity and confirm that requests are sent from the Kling API, and improve the security of callback integrations. Added Test Callback: Send test callback requests to quickly verify your callback configuration. Added Webhook Secret Management: Create, rotate, and delete Webhook Secrets to simplify the management of secrets used for callback signature verification. If Webhook Signature is not enabled, no changes are required to your existing callback integration. Existing functionality remains fully compatible. Updated developer documentation, including the Callback Protocol →, Webhook Signature Integration Guide →, SDK Examples →, and FAQ →. 08/03/2026 Video Generation | Video Effects | New Feature Launch of 3 new video effects: critter_paste, wiggle_faces_pets, paw_headbang For video effects details, refer to: Video Effects Center 07/24/2026 Video Generation | Video Effects | New Feature Launch of 9 new video effects: food_splash, dj_pet, pet_diving, disco_paws, pet_fitness, j_var_live, pet_burst, idol_live, puff_cheeks For video effects details, refer to: Video Effects Center 07/15/2026 General | Feature Upgrade: More video models support the new API (same as Kling 3.0 Turbo API) The new API features a simpler structure and lower parameter coupling, and supports batch queries by task ID and cursor-based pagination. Models added in this update: Kling 3.0, Kling 3.0 Omni, Kling 3.0 Motion Control, Kling 2.6, Kling 2.6 Motion Control, Kling 2.5 Turbo. The legacy API will continue to be available with no current plans for deprecation. Support exporting Markdown documents and quick integration with programming tools. 07/06/2026 General | New Feature Launched: Supports Exporting Deduction Details through API Supports querying resource package deduction details and balance deduction details. Please distinguish between the APIs. When querying deduction details, filtering can be performed based on criteria such as time, API Key, resource package ID, and resource package name. Supports multi-criteria filtering, taking the intersection of conditions of the same type and the union of conditions of different types. Supports the commonly used cursor query method in the industry. When using cursor query, keep the filtering criteria consistent with the initial query. 07/03/2026 Video Generation | Video Effects | New Feature Launch of 4 new video effects: african_sway, jealousy_sway, chubby_fish, shrug_dance For video effects details, refer to: Video Effects Center Notice: magic_match_tree will be discontinued on July 3rd, 2026 06/25/2026 Video Generation | Video Effects | New Feature Launch of 1 new video effects: soccer_star For video effects details, refer to: Video Effects Center 06/18/2026 Video Generation | Video Effects | New Feature Launch of 8 new video effects: bra_hot_dance, arg_hot_dance, fra_hot_dance, bra_goal, arg_goal, por_goal, victory_slide, samba_fever For video effects details, refer to: Video Effects Center 06/17/2026 Video Generation | Kling 3.0 Turbo Officially Released Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video generation in 720P and 1080P Billing policy: Charged based on the duration of the generated video. 0.8 units are deducted per second for 720P generation, and 1.0 unit is deducted per second for 1080P generation Parameter optimization reduces parameter conflicts, making integration easier The new API supports authentication via API Key only.
